findings.summary: The criterion 4 demonstration does not name the test that shows a failing recorded test check is rejected.
findings.evidence: No new test is planned for this case. An existing test covers it: lifecycle.rs:385 `a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier_and_every_criterion_is_judged` deletes README.md, and the fixture's `test` check (common/mod.rs:48-50, which runs `test -f README.md`) then fails, so the verdict is Rejected. The `full_test_report("fail")` case at lifecycle.rs:1491 is a failure the producer reported, not a check Athena recorded, so it does not show rejection. Fix: Name lifecycle.rs `a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier_and_every_criterion_is_judged` (and the check-failure test near line 861) as the rejection evidence in the criterion 4 demonstration, and keep them unchanged.
findings.location: Plan, Demonstrations, criterion 4 (the case where a recorded failing test check is rejected)

findings.summary: A diff stat cannot show that the check and verdict code is unchanged, because run.rs is itself modified.
findings.evidence: The demonstration uses `git diff --stat` to show that no check or verdict code changed. run.rs is itself a modified file, and a stat cannot show which parts of run.rs changed. Fix: Cite the run.rs diff hunks to show that only the producer loop, the constants and the gaps note changed. Rely on the criterion 4 rejection test for the behavior, and add `git diff -- crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md` (expected empty).

findings.summary: fake.rs reports a passing `cargo test --locked` in two places; the plan mentions only one.
findings.evidence: fake.rs reports `cargo test --locked` in two places, line 232 and line 274. The plan describes only a single fake report. Fix: Read both places. Change or remove both if they exist only to satisfy the gate, and grep crates/ for tests that assert on those fake check entries.

findings.summary: The rewritten no-change test must drop its assertion on the `cargo test --locked` text.
findings.evidence: lifecycle.rs:1464 asserts that the failure reason contains "cargo test --locked". Once the gate is gone, that text will not appear in the reason. Fix: State that the rewrite drops the assertion at line 1464 and keeps only the 'made no change' assertion and the no-verifier assertion.
findings.location: Plan, Step 4 (the no-change test at lifecycle.rs:1449)

summary: I read the snapshot with Read and Grep only and ran nothing. The plan matches the request and the accepted reading. Every name it says to remove exists in run.rs: FULL_TEST_COMMAND at line 1164, ran_full_tests at 1170, enforce_tests at 1342, tests_missing at 1411 to 1467, and the gaps note at 1771. The plan removes the rule where it starts, in the prompt line and the loop gate, and keeps the unmet-criteria send-back and PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS. Removing enforce_tests does not leave pins_repo unused, because run.rs still calls it at lines 366 and 818. The doc spots it names exist and are the right ones: decisions.md D95 at line 2133 and the D103 text at 2377, athena-v0.md lines 772 and 1780, and the CHANGELOG D95 entry at lines 615 to 621. The lifecycle tests it plans to rewrite (lines 1368 to 1505) and the job_plan comment at line 119 exist too. The criterion 4 demonstration would fail with the gate still in place, because the not-run test would see 2 producer calls. I found no blocker or major problem. The minor gaps: the plan does not name which test shows the rejection when the recorded test check fails; the criterion 3 demonstration is weak, since run.rs is in the diff and a stat cannot show which parts changed; and fake.rs has a second `cargo test --locked` claim the plan does not mention.
